findings.message: Every row's Activity column reads "0 published · 0 downloads": ClawHub's publisher stats, zero-filled for records that publish and download nothing. The column states nothing true about the record.
findings.remediation: Show a value the record has (e.g. licence type or status) in the stat slot, or no stat column. Copy/hierarchy change: human review.
findings.reference: openclaw-design-audit/references/rubric.md (copy/clarity); openclaw-carapace/references/application-surfaces.md ("Give master lists identity, status, and one useful comparison value")

findings.message: At 375px every record name is cut with an ellipsis (98 clipped text elements; "JADE LEARNING LLC" gets 104px) because the row also carries a synthetic handle "@entity-<id>" and the zero download stat; the licence and status line is hidden at that width.
findings.remediation: Drop the synthetic handle and the zero stat so the name gets the row's width. Changes rendered content: human review.
findings.reference: openclaw-design-audit/references/rubric.md (layout/overflow); openclaw-carapace/references/application-surfaces.md ("Confirm that long labels and descriptions wrap without resizing fixed UI")

findings.message: The registers are listed under ClawHub's fixed sidebar heading "Categories" / "All categories" (src/components/BrowseControls.tsx:587), so a register reads as a category.
findings.remediation: Name the dimension the sidebar lists, on the same pattern used for the state and city selects. Copy change: human review.

findings.message: While loading, the list header reads "Record / Downloads" (BrowseResultsSkeleton label and its fixed stat label); once loaded it reads "Name / Activity". The header changes words between states.
findings.remediation: Pass the loaded header's first label to the skeleton (label="Name"); the skeleton's fixed "Downloads" stays until the stat column is decided.
